note: Farmer messages with the reading a careful person would make under Mifugo's rule: a vague time resolves to the LATEST moment it could mean, capped at now. A parsed dose time EARLIER than expected is a dangerous error, because it ends the withdrawal too soon. Written by the team; replace and extend with real messages from farmers before trusting the numbers.
